english: A classmate did not come to class today. I called him and asked why he did not come to school. He said he was sick and went to see a doctor in the morning.
reference: 我的同学今天没有来上课。我给他打电话,问他为什么没有来学校。他说他生病了,上午去看病了。
topic: Asking why a classmate was absent

issues.description: The English says "A classmate", but the reference has "我的同学", which adds "my". A more literal version would be "一个同学" or "有个同学". Learners who write that could be marked down unfairly.
"看病" for "see a doctor" is slightly above HSK 2, and "看医生" is a common alternative. A strict automatic grader might reject that valid answer.
